definitions.full: H1563. galam [ גָּלַם ] verb wrap up, fold, fold together (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic in derivatives) — Qal Imperfect וַיִּגְלֹם 2Kin 2:8 וַיִּגְלֹם אֶתאַֿדַּרְתּוֺ אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיִּקַּח .
